constraints.source: CDUs shall be liquid-to-liquid, modular and placed in mechanical galleries with N+1 group redundancy. They take facility water on the primary side and cool a separate technical-grade secondary loop that serves GPU cold plates at a design flow of at least 1.5 LPM per kW
